rationale: Price has slipped below the 9-EMA ($5.18) and the most recent candle (highest volume of the three post-entry bars at 51k shares) printed a bearish range—high of $5.24 but close at $5.17 with a wick down to $5.15—suggesting sellers are absorbing any intraday bounce attempt. The maximum favorable excursion of only 0.10% against a maximum adverse excursion of -0.77% confirms the position has moved structurally against the thesis without ever gaining traction, and with the ATR at just $0.04 the remaining upside to target ($5.44) is now disproportionately difficult to achieve in 73 minutes; exiting preserves capital without requiring invalidation to be formally tagged.
